title: Acyclicity of the straight-line gate list
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $ss$ be a finite list of straight-line statements on $n$ inputs. Assume that at every position $i<|ss|$, each line operand in the statement at position $i$ refers to a line with index less than $i$. Then, in the list formed by the $n$ input-negation gates followed by the gates corresponding to the statements in $ss$, every gate at position $i$ reads only vertices with indices less than $n+i$.
hypotheses_covered: $ss$ is a finite list of straight-line statements on $n$ inputs
